subject: Re: Thanks for attending Redwood webinar — schedule a demo?
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood webinar — quick follow-up & demo?

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for joining our "Scaling LLMs for Fintech" webinar today — really glad you could make it. A few attendees mentioned they'd like a short, hands-on demo focused on inference cost controls and low-latency serving for transaction workloads.

If that sounds useful, I'd love to set up a 30-minute demo with our AE, Laura Bennett, to walk through:
- How Redwood reduces per-token cost with batching + caching
- Dedicated vs hosted deployment tradeoffs for regulated data
- A quick Q&A around compliance (SOC 2, audit logs)

Are you available next week for a quick demo? A couple of times that work on our side:
- Tue 11/23, 10:30–11:00 PT
- Tue 11/23, 13:30–14:00 PT
- Wed 11/24, 09:00–09:30 PT

Or feel free to pick a slot that works for you: https://calendly.com/redwood-marissa/demo-30m

I've attached the webinar deck for reference.

Thanks!

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | SDR, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Webinar Deck - Nov 2026.pdf (presentation, 18 slides)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks — the webinar was great. We'd definitely be interested in a short demo. I'm based in SF and afternoons are easiest for me next week. Could we do Tue 11/23 at 1:30pm PT? I'll loop in our SRE, Brian (cc'd) in case there are infra/security questions.

If Laura is leading the demo, great — looking forward to it.

Best,
Alex
Alex Johnson | Head of Platform Engineering
FintechCorp
alex.johnson@fintechcorp.com

Hi Alex —

Great — thanks for confirming. I've penciled in Tue 11/23 at 1:30pm PT and sent a calendar invite (attached). Laura will run the demo and focus on the platform + deployment options; she can also cover our SOC 2 evidence and audit log capabilities if you want.

Please see the tentative invite attached: Redwood Demo Invite.ics. If that time doesn't work for any reason, reply here with a couple of alternatives and we'll adjust.

Agenda (30 mins):
1) 10m — Architecture & deployment options (Laura)
2) 12m — Demo: latency & cost controls (Laura)
3) 8m — Q&A (SRE/infra topics)

Looking forward to it — we've also added the HubSpot record for FintechCorp so I can follow up with any collateral afterwards: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/record/FIN-2345

Thanks,

Confirmed, the 11/23 1:30pm PT time works for us (Laura on the invite looks good). Brian will join for infra/security questions. If anything comes up we'll DM you, otherwise see you then.

One quick ask before the demo: can you send the SOC 2 overview and a short list of what telemetry/audit logs are retained by default? If you have a one-page compliance checklist that would be perfect.
